summary: Eren wakes from a dream he cannot keep. In Shiganshina the Survey Corps comes home short, and then a giant appears over the outer wall.

segments.ja: エレン・イェーガーは、泣きながら目を覚まします。涙の理由は、自分でもつかめません。つかめたのは、誰かの声と、緑の景色と、とても遠い別れだけです。別れの相手は、まだこの街にはいません。いない夢を、母のカルラは普通の寝言として扱います。扱う台所は、シガンシナ区の朝です。朝の光は、壁の影で切れています。切れた光の下で、少年は顔を拭き、夢の続きを捨てます。捨てたはずの絵が、今日の終わりまで彼の胸に残ります。
segments.en: Eren Jaeger wakes up crying. He cannot hold the reason for the tears. What he can hold is a voice, a green view, and a parting that feels very far away. The person in that parting is not in this town yet. His mother, Carla, treats the dream that is not there as ordinary sleep-talk. The kitchen where she treats it is a morning in Shiganshina District. The morning light is cut by the shadow of the wall. Under the cut light, the boy wipes his face and throws away the rest of the dream. The picture he thought he threw away stays in his chest until the end of today.

segments.titleEn: The wall stands in for the sky
segments.ja: シガンシナの人は、壁を景色として育ちます。育つ壁は、ウォール・マリアです。マリアの内側が、彼らの世界の端です。端の向こうに何があるかを、大人は話したがりません。話したがらない静けさを、子供は空の狭さとして知っています。知っている狭さの中で、市場は普通に開きます。開く屋台の魚は、川の魚です。海を見た人は、この朝にはいません。
segments.en: People in Shiganshina grow up with the wall as scenery. The wall they grow up with is Wall Maria. The inside of Maria is the edge of their world. Adults do not like to say what is beyond that edge. Children know the quiet of that dislike as a narrow sky. Inside the narrowness they know, the market opens as usual. The fish on the stalls that open are river fish. Nobody in this morning has seen the sea.

segments.titleJa: 帰ってきた馬が少ない
segments.ja: 調査兵団が、門から戻ってきます。戻る列は、出発の列より短いです。短い理由を、兵士の顔が先に話します。話す前に、町の人は担架と、空の鞍を数えます。数えた損失に、拍手は混ざります。混ざる拍手は、生存への礼と、外へ出たことへの非難です。非難の中で、エレンは翼のマークを見ます。見るマークが、彼の中では自由の形です。形を、母は危険の形として見ています。見ている二つの意味が、同じ門の前でぶつかります。
segments.en: The Survey Corps comes back through the gate. The line that returns is shorter than the line that left. The soldiers' faces tell the reason for the shortness before anyone speaks. Before they speak, the town counts stretchers and empty saddles. Applause mixes into the loss they counted. The mixed applause is thanks for survival and blame for having gone outside. Inside the blame, Eren looks at the mark of the wings. The mark he looks at is, for him, the shape of freedom. His mother sees that shape as the shape of danger. The two meanings she and he are seeing collide in front of the same gate.

segments.ja: 家に戻ったエレンは、調査兵団に入ると言います。言う相手は、カルラです。カルラは、壁の中で十分だと考えます。考える根拠は、今日の空の鞍です。鞍を見た少年は、逆に外の理由を強めます。強める言葉を、ミカサ・アッカーマンは黙って聞きます。聞くミカサは、エレンの安全を自分の仕事にしています。仕事は、彼の夢を止めることではありません。止める代わりに、彼女は隣にいる準備をします。
segments.en: Back at the house, Eren says he will join the Survey Corps. The person he says it to is Carla. Carla thinks the inside of the wall is enough. The ground of that thought is today's empty saddles. The boy who saw the saddles only strengthens his reason for the outside. Mikasa Ackerman listens in silence to the words he strengthens. The Mikasa who listens has made Eren's safety her own work. The work is not to stop his dream. Instead of stopping it, she prepares to stay beside him.

segments.ja: 午後、壁の上に人ではない影が乗ります。乗る影は、蒸気を吐き、目だけが街を見下ろします。見下ろす高さが、百年の平和を一度で終わらせます。終わらせる存在を、兵士は砲で測ろうとします。測る前に、その手が門のほうへ動きます。動く手を、エレンは市場の通りから見上げます。見上げた瞬間、夢の涙が体のどこかで再び熱くなります。熱くなる理由は、まだ言葉になりません。ならないまま、街の音が止まります。
segments.en: In the afternoon, a shadow that is not a person climbs onto the wall. The shadow that climbs breathes steam, and only its eyes look down on the town. The height of that looking-down ends a hundred years of peace in one moment. Soldiers try to measure the being that ends it with cannon. Before they measure, its hand moves toward the gate. Eren looks up at the moving hand from a market street. In the moment he looks up, the tears of the dream grow hot again somewhere in his body. The reason they grow hot does not become words yet. While it does not, the sound of the town stops.

segments.en: From beyond the hole, Titans in a human shape walk in. The speed of their walking is not a hurry. The lack of hurry deepens the town's fear. Inside the deepened fear, people split toward houses, toward the top of the wall, and toward the inner gate. The choice of splitting does not guarantee a correct road. Without a guarantee, the Titans advance down streets at the height of the roofs. The mouths that advance are not waiting for a soldier's blade. The Garrison sees, for the first time in a hundred years, an enemy that is not waiting.

segments.en: Hannes readies a blade in front of the children. The opponent he readies it for is one Titan coming closer slowly. The moment he sees that one, the daytime joke leaves his body. What remains after it leaves is a fear that will not move his feet. Later he will name that fear as his own weakness. Before he names it, he stops trying to fight and lifts Eren and Mikasa. The judgment of lifting them is half of the promise. The half is to protect. The other half, to bring the Titan down, cannot be done today. Eren does not blame the adult who cannot do it yet.

segments.en: Lifted up, Eren looks toward his own house. Carla is under the house he looks at. His mother is among collapsed timber and cannot pull her legs free. The child does not yet fully understand that she cannot. Without understanding, he tries to get down and go back. Hannes stops the hand that tries to go back. The reason he stops it is that if they return now, all three are lost. Eren does not accept the calculation of loss. The shout of not accepting stays in Shiganshina's afternoon.

segments.ja: 壁の上の巨人は、門を壊したあと、すぐに消えません。消えない蒸気が、街の空を白くします。白くした空を、エレンは涙の夢と重ねます。重ねる相手は、まだ顔の見えない誰かです。誰かの別れが、今日の破壊とどうつながるか、彼には分かりません。分からないまま、体だけが知っています。知っている感覚は、これは初めてではない、です。ではない感覚を、物語はまだ説明しません。
segments.en: The Titan on the wall does not vanish immediately after breaking the gate. The steam that does not vanish whitens the town's sky. Eren lays the whitened sky over the dream of tears. The person he lays it over is someone whose face he still cannot see. He does not know how that someone's parting connects to today's destruction. Without knowing, only his body knows. The sense it knows is that this is not the first time. The story does not explain yet the sense that it is not.

segments.en: Armin's book held the outside world as an imagination. The imagination it held enters the town today with feet and a mouth. The world that entered is not salt water. It is not water. vocab.exampleEn: The Survey Corps comes back through the gate. The line that returns is shorter than the line that left. The soldiers' faces tell the reason for the shortness before anyone speaks. vocab.exampleEn: Eren Jaeger wakes up crying. He cannot hold the reason for the tears. What he can hold is a voice, a green view, and a parting that feels very far away. The morning light is cut by the shadow of the wall. Under the cut light, the boy wipes his face and throws away the rest of the dream. The picture he thought he threw away stays in his chest until the end of today.
